items.title: Peter Bocage Interview, 1959-01-29
items.q: Now, this Teal, since you spoke about the A clarinet.

ctx.x: No, he would play, he'd play, he'd get the lead, and then he would make his own improvisions. Variation. Yeah, his variation, his own ideas, you see? But he would, after he'd play it a while, he'd get the melody, you see, and he knew just how to tune what. And that's what he'd been gifted in that type of playing, you know? He knew just what to put in there, see? Now, this Teal, since you spoke about the A clarinet.
